description: Hashes a watched tree with SHA-384 and diffs it against the recorded baseline, filing files that appeared, vanished, or changed.
name: tripwire

signals.description: A file is present in the watched tree that was not in the recorded baseline.
signals.name: file_appeared

signals.description: A file in the recorded baseline is no longer present in the watched tree.
signals.name: file_vanished

signals.description: A watched file's SHA-384 digest changed from the baseline (oversize files compare by size only).
signals.name: file_changed
